Messages.Author: James Hamblin
Messages.Body:
Hidden Lurker [Jyhad, V:TES, SW]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Obfuscate
Usable only by an untapped vampire other than the acting minion after
the acting minion is blocked and combat is over. Tap this vampire. This
vampire now enters combat with the blocking minion. The first round of
combat, the blocking minion cannot use any strikes (not even the default
hand strike). (S) As above, but with an optional press.

Question: Can the blocking minion use additional strikes? I always used
to think so, but it says "The first round of combat, the blocking minion
cannot use any strikes", so it seems like the ban on strikes last the
whole round. This could be another instance of me misrembering an old
Jyhad ruling. Or I could be on crack.

James

I think you're looking for this (under "Combat" in the Rul./Err./Clar.):

You can gain additional strikes even if you cannot strike. You still cannot
strike with the additional strike(s), however. [LSJ 19970821]

("(s)" added myself, for you quote-mongers.)
--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta

will not overcome the restriction against striking.
